issue.title: Nav ! on a BLOCKS line says 'No links found' instead of the BLOCKS generated-line notice
issue.description:
Root cause: the nav `!` / `N!` handler in
plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/500-plugin-transclusion-and-link-picker.js (~line 201)
refuses a Depends-On line with its own notice, but has no `parseBlocksLine` check. On a
🧱 **BLOCKS:** line, `findTransclusionToggleTargets` (180-editor-transactions.js ~407)
returns no targets, so the user sees the generic "No links found on current line" notice.

Repro: in a vault note, put the cursor on a generated `- 🧱 **BLOCKS:** [[#^t1]]` child
line of a #task and press `!`. Expected per bob-cli docs/task-dependencies.md §14.8
("`!` / `N!`, Ctrl+Shift+Enter | Refused with the same notice"): nav's
BLOCKS_GENERATED_LINE_NOTICE ("🧱 BLOCKS is generated from DEPENDS ON lines · edit it
with Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B"). Actual: "No links found on current line". The §14.8 row predates
epic bob-cli-8x (present at 30bdfb8^), so this is a pre-existing gap from the BLOCKS-line
epic (6aef3b6), found during the bob-cli-8x land audit.

Fix: before toggleLineTransclusions, `if (parseBlocksLine(lineText, {}).verdict !==
"not-a-line") { new Notice(BLOCKS_GENERATED_LINE_NOTICE); return false; }`, plus a test.

task_type_fields.impact: Minor: a misleading notice on a generated line; no data change.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the bob-cli-8x land audit: docs/task-dependencies.md §14.8 promises '!' on a BLOCKS line is refused with the generated-line notice, but nav never checks BLOCKS lines in its ! handler. Pre-existing, not caused by bob-cli-8x.

payload.description: bob-cli-8x changed BLOCKS_GENERATED_LINE_NOTICE copy and its remaining-work plan touches the same BLOCKS-line refusals

payload.entry: Resolved by batch-12 phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.2, bob-plugins commit d9823d1. toggleCurrentLineTransclusions now refuses a generated BLOCKS line (parseBlocksLine verdict != not-a-line) with BLOCKS_GENERATED_LINE_NOTICE and no write; the counted N! range path skips BLOCKS lines and shows the same notice. Regression in scripts/test-navigation-hotkeys-dependencies.cjs covers ! and N! on a BLOCKS line (notice, no transactions) and an ordinary link line still toggling. Ctrl+Shift+Enter already refused BLOCKS lines (phase check). Lander verified source on master; vault bob-navigation-hotkeys 2.56.4 is byte-identical to the repo main.js/manifest/styles.
